# getstream_app_settings (Resource)

Manage the GetStream.io application-level settings singleton (GET/PUT `/api/v2/app`): event delivery (SQS/SNS), webhooks, uploads, moderation, and behavior toggles. There is exactly one of these per app. Note: secret fields (`sqs_secret`, `sns_secret`) are write-only — GetStream does not return them, so they are kept from configuration and not refreshed for drift detection.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# App settings are a singleton — declare one getstream_app_settings per app/provider.
# You manage only the fields you set; unset fields are left untouched on the app.
resource "getstream_app_settings" "this" {
  # Event delivery (secrets are write-only; not read back from the API).
  sqs_url    = "https://sqs.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/000000000000/getstream-events"
  sqs_key    = "AKIAEXAMPLE"
  sqs_secret = var.sqs_secret

  # Webhooks.
  webhook_url    = "https://api.example.com/getstream/webhook"
  webhook_events = ["message.new", "channel.created"]

  # Upload rules.
  file_upload_config = {
    blocked_file_extensions = [".exe", ".sh"]
  }

  # Behavior toggles.
  async_url_enrich_enabled = true
  reminders_interval       = 60
}

variable "sqs_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  default   = null
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `async_url_enrich_enabled` (Boolean) Enable asynchronous URL enrichment.
- `auto_translation_enabled` (Boolean) Enable automatic message translation.
- `before_message_send_hook_url` (String) URL for the before-message-send hook.
- `channel_hide_members_only` (Boolean) Hide channels for members only on deletion.
- `custom_action_handler_url` (String) URL for the custom action handler.
- `disable_auth` (Boolean) Disable auth checks (development only).
- `disable_permissions` (Boolean) Disable permission checks (development only).
- `file_upload_config` (Attributes) Allowed/blocked file extensions and MIME types for file uploads. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--file_upload_config))
- `image_moderation_enabled` (Boolean) Whether AWS Rekognition image moderation is enabled.
- `image_moderation_labels` (List of String) Moderation labels to block.
- `image_upload_config` (Attributes) Allowed/blocked file extensions and MIME types for image uploads. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--image_upload_config))
- `multi_tenant_enabled` (Boolean) Enable multi-tenant (teams) mode.
- `permission_version` (String) Permission system version (e.g. "v1" or "v2").
- `reminders_interval` (Number) Reminders interval in seconds.
- `sns_key` (String) Access key for the SNS topic.
- `sns_secret` (String, Sensitive) Secret key for the SNS topic. Write-only; not returned by the API.
- `sns_topic_arn` (String) ARN of the SNS topic GetStream publishes events to.
- `sqs_key` (String) Access key for the SQS queue.
- `sqs_secret` (String, Sensitive) Secret key for the SQS queue. Write-only; not returned by the API.
- `sqs_url` (String) URL of the SQS queue GetStream publishes events to.
- `webhook_events` (List of String) Event types delivered to the webhook URL.
- `webhook_url` (String) URL GetStream posts webhook events to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier (fixed; app settings are a singleton).
